subject: ClearWave onboarding: benchmark acceptance plan and implementation schedule
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearwave.com>, ClearWave SRE <sre@clearwave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: ClearWave onboarding: benchmark acceptance plan and implementation schedule

Tom / SRE team —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion, attached is the proposed acceptance plan for the onboarding benchmark run. High-level summary and asks below so your team can review ahead of the run window next week.

Acceptance targets (pass/fail):
- Median p50 latency: <= 120ms for 8k prompt distribution (endpoint: /v1/generate)
- 99th percentile tail: <= 450ms for single-token streaming spikes
- Sustained throughput: 7.5k RPS sustained for 20m with average token size 24
- Error rate: < 0.2% (5xx + timeouts)

Planned run components:
1) Dry run (prefix replay, no KV cache warm) — validate baseline kernel selection
2) Warm run (KV cache primed, normal batching) — primary acceptance window
3) Stress ramp (burst 2x for 5m) — observe graceful degradation and fallback to smaller model variant

What we need from ClearWave this week:
- Confirm a 3-hour window on Thursday 2026-07-16 (12:00–15:00 PT) for the main acceptance run
- Provide a signed copy of the data handling addendum (we have a DocuSign link below)
- Share any synthetic traffic scripts you prefer to run alongside our generators (we can merge)

Attachments: clearwave-benchmark-plan-v1.pdf (plan), telemetry-schema.json (required metrics), loadscript-20260714.yml (our load generation config)

I'll loop in Monica from CS; she'll own telemetry and evidence collection during the run. If that window doesn't work, propose an alternate date/time.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference for production LLMs

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearwave.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearWave SRE <sre@clearwave.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearWave onboarding: benchmark acceptance plan and implementation schedule

Kim —

Appreciate the clear plan. Thursday 07/16 12:00–15:00 PT is acceptable for us. A few quick clarifications from our SREs:

1) For the 7.5k RPS target, is that measured at the ingress load balancer or at the application layer after the gateway? We need to align so we don't double-count frontend retries.
2) Can Redwood run the Warm run first (KV priming) and then the Dry run? Our preferred sequence is warm->dry->stress to avoid cold-start variance in the metrics.
3) We will supply a concurrent synthetic script that simulates 40% chat traffic and 60% completion traffic. We'll share it by EOD Wed.

Also, one operational ask: our security team wants the telemetry schema to include request_id and k8s_pod_id fields so we can correlate traces in our APM tooling. Is that easy to add to telemetry-schema.json?

I'll sign the DAA once I see the final DocuSign link. Thanks — looking forward to the run.

Tom Alvarez
Director of Platform Engineering | ClearWave

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearwave.com>, ClearWave SRE <sre@clearwave.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearWave onboarding: benchmark acceptance plan and implementation schedule

Thanks Tom — great questions. A couple of operational notes and confirmations from the CS/Operations side: 

- Measurement point: Our acceptance metrics are measured at the Redwood inference node (application layer) after gateway retries, to reflect real per-token generation cost. We will provide both LB and node-level counters in the telemetry bundle to help reconcile with your ingress metrics.

- Sequence: We can run Warm -> Dry -> Stress as you requested. We'll adjust the runbook accordingly and note the reasoning in the post-run artifact.

- Telemetry schema: We can add request_id and k8s_pod_id to telemetry-schema.json. I've attached an updated snippet (telemetry-schema.json) with both fields required for the run. Please confirm that field formats match your APM (trace_id as hex string, pod id as short UUID).

- Evidence collection & artifacts: During the run Redwood will capture:
  * Node-level latency histograms (p50/p95/p99), token-level tokenization counts
  * GPU utilization and kernel selection logs (per-step kernel id),
  * Batching stats (batch sizes distribution),
  * Request traces for any 5xx or timeouts (with full prompt redaction)

- Attachments: I uploaded the updated telemetry-schema.json and the loadscript we will use (loadscript-20260714.yml). Ben will run the load generator from our staging region and sit on the call for the main run.

Operational asks for ClearWave SRE: please provision a short-lived VPN access token for our runner (expiry 24h) and confirm the CIDR range we'll be testing from.

Open items:
- DAA DocuSign link (Tom)
- Synthetic traffic script from ClearWave (Tom/SRE)
- VPN token and CIDR confirmation (ClearWave SRE)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: telemetry-schema.json (updated), loadscript-20260714.yml

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearwave.com>, ClearWave SRE <sre@clearwave.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 15:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearWave onboarding: benchmark acceptance plan and implementation schedule — Run evidence and next steps

On Thu, 16 Jul 2026 at 13:10:02 -0700 Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearwave.com> wrote:
> Thanks everyone — run looks good from our side. We saw the KV warm run stabilize after ~6 minutes.

Quick summary of the evidence bundle from Redwood (attached to the Drive link):
- Acceptance pass: all four acceptance targets met in the Warm run window (median=98ms, p99=412ms, sustained throughput=7.6k RPS, error rate=0.07%)
- Stress ramp: graceful degradation observed; automatic fallback to 8-bit quantized model kept median latency within 1.15x of baseline under 2x burst
- Artifacts: latency_histograms-20260716.csv, gpu-kernel-log-20260716.tar.gz (refer to Drive), batch-distribution-20260716.csv, request-traces-20260716.json (prompts redacted)

Next steps we recommend:
1) Post-run review call — propose Mon 2026-07-20 10:00 PT to walk artifacts and any tuning needs
2) If you want to lock in Dedicated capacity for production, we can attach a Reserved SKU proposal; I'll have the finance team send a draft by EOD Monday
3) Onboarding checklist: production DNS cutover, alerting runbook handoff, and SLO alerts (we'll provide starter rules)

Tom — please confirm you'd like the Monday review and whether we should invite your security lead for the artifact walkthrough.

Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: latency_histograms-20260716.csv, gpu-kernel-log-20260716.tar.gz, batch-distribution-20260716.csv, request-traces-20260716.json
